provenance_quote: The extracellular alkaline protease produced by Pseudomonas aeruginosa is secreted by a specific pathway, independent of the pathway used by most of the other extracellular proteins of this organism.
notes: Q03023 = P. aeruginosa PAO1 AprA serralysin, OrderedLocusName PA1249, organism matches ledger; UniProt SUBCELLULAR LOCATION Secreted. DOI = Guzzo et al. 1991 Mol Microbiol, secretion genes related to E. coli alpha-haemolysin T1SS. All identifiers match.

provenance_quote: Secreted by an ABC transporter (type I) secretion apparatus
notes: P35828 = Caulobacter crescentus CB15 S-layer protein RsaA, gene rsaA, OrderedLocusName CC_1007, organism matches ledger. UniProt explicitly annotates secretion via type I ABC transporter. DOI 10.1128/JB.180.12.3062-3069.1998 resolves (Awram & Smit). Identifiers correct.

provenance_quote: As for E. coli alpha-haemolysin, secretion of B.pertussis adenylate cyclase and haemolysin requires the expression of additional genes. The gene products of cyaB and cyaD are highly similar to HlyB and HlyD
notes: Secretion claim holds: Glaser 1988 EMBO J (PMID 2905265, PMC455007, DOI 10.1002/j.1460-2075.1988.tb03288.x) shows CyaA secreted via cyaB/cyaD (HlyB/HlyD homologs) = T1SS/RTX. BUT UniProt P0DKX7 is Bordetella pertussis Tohama I, OrderedLocusName BP0760, NOT B. bronchiseptica RB50 (ledger genome BX470248). BP0760 is a B. pertussis Tohama I tag, not an RB50 tag. Organism/genome mismatch; protein identity (CyaA, accession) correct. new_locus_tag BB0875 is the B. bronchiseptica RB50 cyaA tag if RB50 genome is intended; otherwise organism should be corrected to B. pertussis Tohama I.

provenance_quote: PrtA, which shows homology to the Erwinia chrysanthemi metalloproteases, is efficiently secreted by E. coli cells carrying the E. chrysanthemi ABC exporter PrtD (ABC protein)-PrtE (MFP)-PrtF (OMP).
notes: UniProt Q7N8R3 = Photorhabdus laumondii subsp. laumondii TT01, gene prtA, OrderedLocusName plu0655 (matches effector_locus and genome BX470251 = Photorhabdus TT01). Ledger organism field 'Dickeya chrysanthemi' is WRONG; accession+locus+genome all point to Photorhabdus. Secretion claim for PrtA-type serralysin via ABC/PrtDEF T1SS holds (Akatsuka 1997 PMID 9244262). Fix = correct organism to Photorhabdus laumondii.

provenance_quote: Note=Is probably secreted via the associated Type 1 transporter encoded by aprDEF.
notes: UniProt Q1ID47 = Pseudomonas entomophila L48 metalloprotease AprA, OrderedLocusName PSEEN1550 (matches effector_locus and genome CT573326 = P. entomophila L48). Ledger organism field 'Pseudomonas aeruginosa PAO1' is WRONG; accession+locus+genome all point to P. entomophila L48. UniProt states secreted via Type 1 transporter aprDEF. Primary_ref (Guzzo 1991) is the P. aeruginosa AprA homolog, not this exact protein. Secretion claim (AprA T1SS) holds; fix = correct organism to P. entomophila L48.

provenance_quote: This demonstrated that a unique exporter, the Lip apparatus, in S. marcescens secretes both LipA and PrtA.
notes: P23694 = Serratia marcescens serralysin (extracellular metalloprotease = PrtA), organism matches ledger. Akatsuka 1997 (PMID 9244262, PMC179321, DOI 10.1128/jb.179.15.4754-4760.1997) shows S. marcescens PrtA/serralysin secreted via the Lip (ABC/T1SS) apparatus. citation_quote verbatim from abstract. Identifiers consistent.

provenance_quote: The genes of the apxI operon will have the designations apxIC, apxIA, apxIB, and apxID for the activator, the structural gene and the two secretion genes respectively.
notes: P55128 = Actinobacillus pleuropneumoniae ApxIA (apxIA), organism matches; UniProt = RTX toxin, Secreted, with apxIB/apxID T1SS secretion genes. DOI = Frey et al. 1993 J Gen Microbiol (RTX-toxin nomenclature), resolves. ApxIA is the structural RTX (T1SS) toxin. Identifiers correct.

provenance_quote: Actinobacillus pleuropneumoniae haemolysin II is secreted from Escherichia coli by A. pleuropneumoniae pleurotoxin secretion gene products
notes: P15377 = A. pleuropneumoniae ApxIIA (apxIIA), organism matches; UniProt = RTX toxin family, Secreted. DOI = Macdonald 1993 FEMS Microbiol Lett, title confirms ApxII secreted via RTX secretion gene products (HlyB/HlyD-type T1SS). Identifiers correct.

provenance_quote: ApxIII could be secreted from E. coli by the heterologous RTX transporter proteins HlyB and HlyD
notes: P55131 = A. pleuropneumoniae ApxIIIA (apxIIIA), organism matches; UniProt = RTX toxin family, Secreted. DOI = Jansen et al. 1993 Infect Immun, ApxIII secreted via heterologous HlyB/HlyD RTX transporter (T1SS); apxIIIA = structural RTX toxin gene. Identifiers correct.

provenance_quote: HasA has a C-terminal targeting sequence and is secreted by a specific ATP binding cassette (ABC) transporter consisting of three proteins
notes: Q54450 = Serratia marcescens hemophore HasA (hasA), organism matches; UniProt SUBCELLULAR LOCATION Secreted (HasDEF ABC exporter). DOI = Letoffe, Ghigo & Wandersman 1994 J Bacteriol, HasA secreted by three-protein ABC (T1SS) transporter via C-terminal signal. Identifiers correct.

provenance_quote: All four hemolysin cistrons (transcriptional order, C, A, B, and D) were encoded on the same DNA strand, and their predicted molecular masses were, respectively, 19.7, 109.8, 79.9, and 54.6 kilodaltons.
notes: P08715 = Escherichia coli alpha-hemolysin HlyA (hlyA), organism matches; UniProt RTX prokaryotic toxin family (TC 1.C.11), secreted via HlyB/HlyD/TolC = prototypical T1SS. DOI = Felmlee, Pellett & Welch 1985 J Bacteriol (hlyCABD operon), resolves. Identifiers correct.

provenance_quote: a heteroplasmid complementation system was developed that permits secretion of the leukotoxin from cells expressing the hemolysin transport proteins HlyB and HlyD
notes: P0C082 = Mannheimia (Pasteurella) haemolytica leukotoxin LktA (lktA), organism matches; UniProt RTX toxin family (TC 1.C.11), Secreted, LktBD ABC transporter. DOI = Highlander, Engler & Weinstock 1990 J Bacteriol, leukotoxin secreted via HlyB/HlyD (T1SS). Identifiers correct.

provenance_quote: TdeA, a TolC-like protein required for toxin and drug export in Aggregatibacter (Actinobacillus) actinomycetemcomitans
notes: P16462 = Aggregatibacter actinomycetemcomitans leukotoxin LtxA (ltxA), organism matches; UniProt RTX toxin family (TC 1.C.11), Secreted. DOI = Crosby & Kachlany 2007 Gene, TolC-like TdeA required for LtxA (RTX/T1SS) export. Identifiers correct.

notes: Q07295 = Dickeya/Erwinia chrysanthemi serralysin PrtA (prtA), organism matches ledger. Akatsuka 1997 (PMID 9244262, DOI 10.1128/jb.179.15.4754-4760.1997) shows E. chrysanthemi PrtA secreted via PrtDEF ABC exporter (T1SS). Identifiers correct.
